name: Sigiriya Rock Fortress
description: Climb the ancient citadel rising above the central plains, then trace its water gardens, frescoes and extraordinary history.
imageAlt: Sigiriya Rock Fortress rising above the green landscape of Sri Lanka

name: Ella
description: A laid-back hill-country escape of tea-covered slopes, waterfall walks and the iconic Nine Arch Bridge.
imageAlt: A scenic train crossing the Nine Arch Bridge in Ella

name: Galle Fort
description: Wander ramparts, lanes and old merchant houses inside a living coastal fort shaped by centuries of Indian Ocean trade.
imageAlt: Historic Galle Fort and its colonial-era streets on Sri Lanka's southern coast

name: Mirissa
description: A palm-fringed south-coast bay for warm-water swims, fresh seafood, surf lessons and slow sunset evenings.
imageAlt: Palm trees overlooking the soft sand and ocean at Mirissa beach

name: Yala National Park
description: Explore dry-zone wilderness, lagoons and scrub forest on a safari in one of Sri Lanka's best-known national parks.
imageAlt: An elephant walking along a safari track in Yala National Park

name: Anuradhapura
description: Discover a sacred ancient capital of immense stupas, monastery ruins and centuries-old reservoirs beneath wide skies.
imageAlt: A great white stupa rising among trees in the ancient city of Anuradhapura

name: Dambulla Cave Temple
description: Step into five atmospheric cave shrines filled with Buddhist murals and statues, set high above the surrounding plains.
imageAlt: The golden and white Dambulla Cave Temple set against a rocky hill

name: Nuwara Eliya
description: Breathe in the cool highlands among rolling tea estates, misty mornings, colonial-era gardens and scenic rail journeys.
imageAlt: Misty green tea country surrounding Nuwara Eliya in Sri Lanka's central highlands

name: Arugam Bay
description: A relaxed east-coast surf town known for its long point break, sandy bays, lagoon trips and easy-going evenings.
imageAlt: An aerial view of the sandy shoreline and boats at Arugam Bay

name: Udawalawe National Park
description: Look for elephant herds, water birds and open grassland on a game drive around the park's wide reservoir.
imageAlt: A family of Sri Lankan elephants moving through open dry-zone woodland
